# Student Offers

> Verified student discounts, offer verification guidance, and student savings guides from Student Offers.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.studentoffers.co/.md): Browse verified student discounts across categories.
- [All Tools](https://www.studentoffers.co/tools.md): Search and browse the public student offer directory.
- [How We Verify](https://www.studentoffers.co/how-we-verify.md): Learn how Student Offers reviews and re-checks offers.
- [Blog](https://www.studentoffers.co/blog.md): Student discount guides, explainers, and comparison articles.
- [Privacy Policy, Cookies & Terms](https://www.studentoffers.co/privacy-cookies-terms.md): Public privacy, cookie, and legal policy information.

## Agent Endpoints
- [tools.md](https://www.studentoffers.co/tools.md): Machine-readable offer directory for agents and integrations.
